vectors.precondition: A valid product-session proof was issued for a different requestingProduct or productClientId.
vectors.expectedState: no mutation; proof not accepted for Resource Market

vectors.precondition: A valid exact-method/path/body product-session proof has already been consumed once.
vectors.action: Replay the same proof against the same request.
vectors.expectedState: no second mutation; replay set remains persisted

vectors.precondition: Order is accepted, capacity_reserved, service_started, metered_usage or service_completed but not settlement_pending.
vectors.expectedState: order state unchanged; no receipt created; capacity not released

vectors.precondition: Order is settlement_pending with signed metering totals.
vectors.action: Settlement authority submits a receipt whose grossCost, providerNet or protocolFee differs from signed metering.
vectors.expectedState: order remains settlement_pending; no receipt created; reserved capacity retained

vectors.precondition: A normalized transaction hash has already been consumed by an existing Resource Market receipt.
vectors.action: Settlement authority submits the same transaction hash with different case or surrounding whitespace for another order.
vectors.expectedState: second order remains settlement_pending; no second receipt created; no double capacity release

vectors.precondition: Provider worker key is active and a canonical meter payload was signed.
vectors.action: Change quantity, interval, order, provider, source or signature before record_usage.
vectors.expectedState: no meter, billing event or order transition

vectors.precondition: At least one signed usage interval is already accepted for the order.
vectors.action: Submit another interval that overlaps any accepted interval or begins before evidenced service start.
vectors.expectedState: no additional meter or billing event; accepted usage remains unchanged

vectors.precondition: The order already contains one or more accepted signed usage segments.
vectors.action: Submit a segment that makes cumulative usage exceed ordered units or breaks cumulative fee lineage.
vectors.expectedState: no additional meter; cumulative quantity and fee totals remain bounded

vectors.precondition: The authenticated buyer wallet is the wallet that owns the selected provider offer.
vectors.action: Create a fixed-price quote or submit an auction bid for the provider's own capacity.
vectors.expectedState: no quote, bid, order, reservation, usage or settlement mutation

vectors.precondition: One provider publishes two offers for the same resource and the first offer is fully reserved while the second retains capacity.
vectors.action: Request or reserve additional units against the exhausted first offer.
vectors.expectedState: the exhausted offer remains unavailable; sibling offer capacity is not borrowed; existing reservations remain unchanged

vectors.precondition: Provider reports failure for an active reserved order.
vectors.action: Observe order, receipt and dispute state before an independently evidenced final decision and authoritative refund transaction.
vectors.expectedState: order becomes provider_failed; reservation releases; no receipt or refund is fabricated; dispute may be opened
